summary: Registration intake readiness remains blocked. Evidence reviewed: `.ai_factory/delivery/intakes/13612888-96ef-4fa4-a304-4a400d9f2e24.md` requests Google/GitHub registration for module `feedback`; `.ai_factory/docs/project-brief.md` confirms Next.js, TypeScript, and Playwright but leaves module constraints and acceptance expectations unspecified. `.env.local` now has active Google OAuth, GitHub OAuth, and `DATABASE_URL` variable names, so the prior database-variable blocker is resolved. Remaining blockers: no `AUTH_SECRET` or `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` variable was found; `package.json` has Prisma CLI only and no `@prisma/client` or auth dependency such as NextAuth/Auth.js; `Test-Path prisma` returned `False`, and targeted source search found no Prisma schema, `datasource db`, `generator client`, or `User`/`Account`/`Customer`/`Session` models. `.ai_factory/delivery/planning` is missing: `Get-ChildItem -Force .ai_factory\delivery\planning` failed with `Cannot find path 'C:\workspace\AI\ai_factory_projects\customer-feedback-portal\.ai_factory\delivery\planning' because it does not exist.` No tests were run for this readiness review.

defects.description: The OAuth registration feature needs a secure session/auth secret and an explicit auth/session strategy. Environment inspection found Google/GitHub provider variables and `DATABASE_URL`, but no `AUTH_SECRET` or `NEXTAUTH_SECRET`; source/dependency search found no selected auth implementation such as NextAuth/Auth.js.

Prisma is not initialized enough to support customer record creation. `package.json` includes `prisma` CLI only, not `@prisma/client`; `Test-Path prisma` returned `False`; and targeted search found no Prisma schema, datasource, generator, or customer/user/account/session data model.

No iteration plan exists under `.ai_factory/delivery/planning`, and project documentation does not define registration acceptance behavior such as callback route expectations, post-registration redirects, duplicate provider-account linking, required persisted customer fields, or admin/customer visibility rules.
